x: Our junior members also gained several award, with Dennis Fleming winning the Discus, and being second in the Javelin. His brother, Alan, was also second in the Long Jump, and G. Osmint ran well to finish third in the 220 Yards.
Platt occupied the same position in the 880 Yards event. In fact third position was the best we could manage in most of the events, but G. Osmint scored a good win for the Club in the 220 Yards.

Held at Tooting on July 17th, this proved a very closely fought match between the home club, the Polytechnic Juniors, and our lads. Dick Negus ran well to gain third place in the 100, while G. Osmint also did well in finishing second in the 220 Yards.
Geoffrey Osmint finished third in the 220, and the final result saw us scoring 16 points to finish joint fourth, which was a good effort with the six leading clubs in the South competing.
In the club handicap events, the 100 yards was won by Geoff.
Geoff. Osmint, now a gunner in B.A.O.R., sends greetings and says he couldn't attend the A.G.M. for this reason.
Geoff Osmint won the open 100 yards at the same meeting and “ Ginger ” Holtum was 3rd after winning the Open 100 at the Watford meeting on Whit-Saturday.
In fact one club member described it as "disgusting" and so the home club were easy winners by scoring 72 points to our 34. Geoff.

" Ginger " Holtum won the 100 yards senior event, and Geoff Osmint showed good form in the 220 yards to gain us yet another win. Jack Brown won the half-mile, with Len Bishop in fourth place, and his brother, Alan, finished third in the 440 yards.

Jack Brown also took a team up to Scotland and with himself running the half-mile, Alan Sexton the quarter and “Ginger” Holtum and Geoff. Osmint the two 220's, they duly won the 1 mile relay at Hawick.

… both the sprint relay, in which the team was : Lowers, Sexton, Craft and Holtum, and the medley relay, in which we had Geoff Osmint and Jim Heathfield doing the two half-laps with Badiali finishing up over the final one lap to win a good race from the North representative.…
